fixed_scope: Five autonomous tracked desk pets with distinct memory and speech, natural interruption, OLED, camera, touch and handling, lift/grip, exploration, games and optional physical accessory modules. One fully featured core repeated five times.
architecture: Mac owner for fleet/memory/AI; XIAO ESP32S3 Sense for camera, microphone, display, speaker and facial response; WROOM32 local actuator/safety controller; two isolated I2C multiplexers and reusable plug-in sensor harness.

parts.name: Independent powered 38 kHz classic NEC dock beacon controller and programmable board
parts.notes: One per dock, not a second robot MCU. Source reuse candidate: Arduino-IRremote MIT sendNEC on supported AVR, or design adaptation of Apache-2.0 OOMWOO CH32V003 dock PCB. OOMWOO's 20V 4S power and contact switching CANNOT be reused for this robot's 1S/5V charger. Source-reused Arduino Nano ATmega328P BENCH emitter now exists at code/firmware/dock (Arduino-IRremote 4.7.1). Exact final compact controller, flashing/debug provision, physical carrier and optical/thermal behavior remain unqualified; no production SKU.

parts.name: Two independently aimed 940 nm 38 kHz infrared LED emitter channels with rated transistor driver and current limiting per dock
parts.notes: Two aimed LED channels per dock driven simultaneously with the SAME classic NEC frame, because current WROOM DualIrEvidence requires equal code at both receivers. Based on OOMWOO IR BEACON KiCad Apache-2.0 design, but OOMWOO separate left/right codes are NOT compatible unchanged; number of LEDs per channel, driver, resistor and final 5V supply must be dimensioned, no naked LED wired to MCU pin. Protocol and baffle must be measured against WROOM dual receiver RMT NEC decoder, never authorize charging by light.

mcp23017_optional_inputs.note: Read only GPIOB 0x13 for slow reed and PIR after a fresh required GPIOA 0x12 dock read. Reserved WROOM GPIO36 and 39 are for two direct terminal IR receivers, and source now implements two legacy ESP-IDF 4.4 RMT read-only receivers and bounded full 34-symbol NEC decoder. No final movement/charging authorizer or physically verified board, optical baffle or RTC ADC glitch filtering exists.

channels.purpose: Eight petting electrodes plus owned/unverified approved heartbeat pad
channels.note: Common CAP1188 0x29 is now supported by verified 0x70 off then isolated 0x71 lane0, with 0x28 strapped alternative. Physical mux faults and electrical levels still need testing.
BMP280 chip address may be 0x76 or 0x77; inspect actual breakout

bus.critical_policy: Firmware in code/firmware/body/TofBus and AccessorySensors already implements eight VL53L0X in esp32_full and bounded raw reads for the listed 0x71 channels including bounded PN532 toy NFC scans and a read only UID game token, but all remain unqualified on actual breakouts. 0x71 mux is quiesced ahead of critical 0x70 ToF reads; failed quiesce faults the local guard. The complete esp32_full profile additionally REQUIRES an installed fresh MCP23017 dock monitor; missing/invalid/stale GPIOA data or either seat contact locally blocks or stops motion. All source drivers require real breakout-specific voltage, lens, time, and behavior measurements and camera, remembered text, peer messages and AI must never arm the local motor guard or certify charging.
bus.head_policy: Sense camera/mic are fixed; GPIO9 can be RGB only after confirming SD disabled and actual shipped board routing. Face bus 5/6 never connected to body Wire.
bus.power_policy: One protected 1S cell/pack and charger with load sharing, 5V regulator sized to measured concurrent head/WROOM/steppers/servo/audio current, independent 3.3V sensor regulator. No bare cell charger contacts or 5V MCU GPIO.
bus.voltage_policy: Only 3.3V I2C/GPIO at WROOM. Check every generic carrier VCC rail, pullups and level shifting. GPIO34 to 39 have no internal pulls. Bumper is two NC contacts in series to ground with external 3.3V pullup; normal LOW, collision or disconnected cable HIGH, local raw trip immediately. GPIO35 is input only and has no internal pullup.
bus.pca9685_policy: Not in selected fixed head and two servo system; moving ears, tail or head pan/tilt would require separate validated actuator variant, not a surprise third servo on occupied pins.

room_pod.compute: Reuse the owned Feather nRF52840 by USB as a stationary room pod if it has a suitable UART and I2C allocation; otherwise one generic ESP32C3 module, not five new MCUs.

modules.name: AMG8833 thermal array
modules.location: optional separate thermal station; not needed for core camera vision

modules.name: Station controller with timestamped USB serial protocol, reuse owned Feather nRF52840 if feasible
modules.location: ventilated stationary USB enclosure; no motor or charge authority; owned Feather nRF52840 is a candidate, not yet an approved controller

room_pod.transport: Room pod presents timestamped named readings to Mac over USB; no safety or motor control and no assumption that a missing pod means a person is present.
room_pod.privacy: BLE heart rate, room presence and desktop app data must be explicit opt-in; don't infer personal identity from PIR/radar.
